authoritative.note: 人工精选的 AI 里程碑论文，不按时间限制；以原始论文、官方会议页或 Nature 页面为准。

items.why: Adam 优化器成为深度学习训练最常用的基础算法之一。

items.title: ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks

items.title: Neural Machine Translation by Jointly Learning to Align and Translate

items.title: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners
items.why: GPT-3 展示规模扩展与少样本学习的涌现能力。

items.title: Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models

items.title: Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback

items.title: Training Compute-Optimal Large Language Models
items.why: Chinchilla 重新定义模型规模与训练 token 的配比。

items.title: GPT-4 Technical Report

items.why: 推动开放权重基础模型生态，成为开源大模型的重要起点。

items.title: Llama 2: Open Foundation and Fine-Tuned Chat Models
items.why: 系统说明开放基础模型与对话模型的训练、评测和安全策略。

items.title: DeepSeek-V3 Technical Report
items.why: MoE 大模型的高效训练与推理代表工作，对低成本大模型路线影响显著。

items.title: DeepSeek-R1: Incentivizing Reasoning Capability in LLMs via Reinforcement Learning
items.why: 以强化学习激发推理能力的代表性工作，推动推理模型成为研究热点。

items.title: Qwen2.5 Technical Report
items.why: 覆盖多尺寸、多语言与长上下文能力的开放模型技术报告。

items.title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models
items.why: 提出思维链提示，显著提升大模型的复杂推理能力。

items.title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
items.why: 将推理与工具行动结合，是 AI Agent 的核心基础论文之一。

items.title: Toolformer: Language Models Can Teach Themselves to Use Tools
items.why: 展示语言模型自主调用外部工具的可行路径。

items.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
items.why: 提出 RAG，成为知识增强、搜索问答和企业知识库的基础方法。

items.title: Direct Preference Optimization: Your Language Model is Secretly a Reward Model
items.why: DPO 简化偏好对齐流程，成为 RLHF 之外的重要对齐方法。

items.title: Constitutional AI: Harmlessness from AI Feedback
items.why: 提出基于原则与 AI 反馈的安全对齐框架。

items.title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
items.why: 低秩微调方法，大幅降低大模型适配与部署成本。

items.title: FlashAttention: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention with IO-Awareness
items.why: 重构注意力计算的显存与速度路径，成为长上下文训练基础设施。

items.title: Switch Transformers: Scaling to Trillion Parameter Models with Simple and Efficient Sparsity
items.why: 推动稀疏 MoE 架构在大模型中的规模化应用。

items.why: DDPM 奠定现代扩散生成模型的理论与训练基础。

items.why: 证明扩散模型在图像生成质量上可以超越 GAN。

items.title: High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models
items.why: Latent Diffusion/Stable Diffusion 的基础论文，推动高质量图像生成普及。

items.why: 展示少样本视觉语言模型的跨模态推理能力。

items.why: SAM 推动通用图像分割与视觉基础模型的发展。

items.why: NeRF 开创神经辐射场，成为三维视觉与场景重建的重要基础。

items.title: Mastering the game of Go with deep neural networks and tree search
items.why: AlphaGo 是深度强化学习与复杂博弈结合的里程碑。

items.title: Don't Sleep, Keep Watch: Proactive Perception for Computer-Use Agents
items.summary: NightWatch adds a lightweight streaming watcher to vision-language computer-use agents to keep perception synchronized with dynamic interfaces, reducing latency and wasted time while maintaining or improving task success.

items.title: Real2SimLab: A Unified Platform for Real-to-Simulation Transfer
items.summary: Real-to-simulation transfer, which builds simulations from real-world observations, has long been studied in research and industry. Recently, coding agents have become capable of generating simulation programs from video recordings, and several benchmarks have been proposed to evaluate them. However, each individual benchmark defines its own inputs, deliverables, and scoring pipeline. This leads to N times M integrations when evaluating N methods on M benchmarks. To this end, we present Real2SimLab, a unified plat…

items.title: Lazy Agents Answer Against Their Own Beliefs: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Beliefs Teaches Them to Act on What They Believe
items.summary: A reinforcement learning method rewards agents for delaying commitment until their inferred posterior over answers is sufficiently narrow, improving evidence-based answering across vision-language benchmarks.

items.title: Rewirable Circuits in Transformers with Loom Attention
items.summary: We propose loom attention, which allows a Transformer to dynamically rewire its circuits at every token by interweaving a head's vertical attention over the outputs of earlier heads (to obtain its query, key and value) with its horizontal attention over tokens. We instantiate vertical attention efficiently with normalized and gated linear attention over a per-token matrix memory, which stores the compressed head outputs and serves as a second residual stream. This yields LoomFormer, a dual-stream architecture that…

items.title: Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation: Pixel as Code for Agentic Visual Creation
items.summary: Visual creation demands expressive imagery together with precise control over text, layout, and structure. We introduce Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation, an agentic framework that connects these capabilities through Pixel as Code. Raster images are represented by learned discrete visual tokens, while structured artifacts use explicit programs. A shared generation-and-rendering interface connects these representations to visual feedback across images, vector graphics, webpages, and documents. A Nemotron-native harness…

items.title: Sage-Med: Scaling Medical Multimodal Intelligence
items.summary: Establishing effective scaling laws for medical multimodal large language models (MLLMs) remains a persistent and fundamental challenge. Our systematic evaluation shows that existing medical MLLMs tend to underperform frontier general-purpose MLLMs across a range of medical tasks, while scaling model size primarily improves text capabilities rather than multimodal perception, and enabling reasoning modes fails to close this visual gap. To investigate how medical multimodal intelligence scales in practice, we intro…

items.title: ACAP: Asynchronous Coding Agents for Efficient Robot Control
items.summary: Coding agents can construct and revise robot behavior during execution, but using one agent for the whole robot can delay otherwise independent work. We introduce Asynchronous Coding Agents as Policy (ACAP), an asynchronous framework that organizes one robot as a team of persistent agents. Each member reasons and acts for a configurable control group, such as an arm with its gripper or the torso and chassis, enabling asynchronous reasoning and execution. However, different robot components often have physical depe…

items.title: Mixture-of-Loops Transformer
items.summary: A Mixture-of-Loops Transformer reuses key-value memory across loops and depths, and its U-shaped variant improves pretraining efficiency and inference latency.

items.title: VibeVideoAgent: Closing the Perceptual Loop for Code-Driven Video Generation
items.summary: Code-driven video generation asks a coding agent to write and run rendering programs. This gives exact control over typography, data visualizations, synchronized audio, and multi-shot scenes, and it leaves an editable project behind. A program that exits cleanly can still render overlapping labels, a camera aimed away from its subject, broken object interactions, or narration that drifts out of sync, and none of these raise a runtime error. Feeding rendered frames and audio back into the coding session bloats its…

items.title: Self-Evolving Evaluation Environments for Computer-Use Agents
items.summary: CUA-SEE is a closed-loop evaluation environment that co-evolves tasks and executable verifiers to adaptively measure computer-use agents’ capabilities, boundaries, and progress reliability.
